---
title: "LCL promoter shape (FANTOM5 GM12878 CAGE)"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
---

Figures of the promoter-shape analysis of the 100 expressed PolII example genes. Tables come from
`01_promoter_shape.R` (run it first: `bash code/promoter_shape/run_promoter_shape.sh`). Each chunk
displays its figure and also writes the same PDF to `LCL_project/promoter_shape/figures/`, so
running chunks in RStudio refreshes the PDFs. Method notes are in `README.md`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
# helpers and parameters only: run_promoter_shape() is not called when the file is sourced
source("/project/spott/cshan/fiber-seq/code/promoter_shape/01_promoter_shape.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(ggplot2); library(patchwork) })
source(file.path(PROJECT, "code/parsing_functions/plotting_functions.r"))   # theme_fiberseq(), save_figure(),
                                                                           # plot_stacked_proportion()

FIG <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "figures")
GROUP_LABELS <- c(housekeeping = "housekeeping", cell_type_specific = "cell type specific")
# Hoskins et al. 2011 Fig. 5 colours: peaked purple, broad green, unclassified grey
CLASS_COLORS <- c(peaked = "#4a3aa7", broad = "#008300", unclassified = "#8c8c8c")
SIDE_COLORS <- c("SI > -1" = "#4a3aa7", "SI <= -1" = "#008300")
SET_SHAPES <- c("dominant_TSS promoter" = 16, "alternative promoter" = 2)
X_OFFSET <- "bp from dominant_TSS (upstream < 0; transcription ->)"
theme_ps <- theme_fiberseq(overrides = list(strip.background = element_blank(),
  strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom",
  plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, colour = "grey30")))

res <- fread(file.path(OUT_DIR, "promoter_shape_annotations.tsv"))
agg <- fread(file.path(OUT_DIR, "CTSS_profiles/aggregated_CTSS_profiles.tsv.gz"))
names <- fantom5_peaks()$peaks[, .(promoter_id, promoter_name)]   # FANTOM5 p<n>@<gene> labels for 05
res <- merge(res, names, by = "promoter_id", all.x = TRUE)
res[, `:=`(gene_group = factor(gene_group, levels = GROUPS),
           promoter_set = factor(fifelse(contains_dominant_TSS, "dominant_TSS promoter", "alternative promoter"),
                                 levels = names(SET_SHAPES)),
           Hoskins_shape_class = factor(Hoskins_shape_class, levels = names(CLASS_COLORS)))]
scored <- res[total_CAGE_tags >= MIN_TAGS]   # promoters with enough tags to classify
scored[, side := factor(fifelse(shape_index > SI_CUT, "SI > -1", "SI <= -1"), levels = names(SIDE_COLORS))]
```

## 1. Shape index distribution by gene group

Shape index of every promoter with at least 20 tags, by gene group. Top row: the promoter that contains dominant_TSS (one per gene); bottom row: alternative promoters. Dashed line: SI = -1.

```{r si-distribution, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
n1 <- scored[, .N, by = .(promoter_set, gene_group)]
sides <- CJ(promoter_set = levels(scored$promoter_set), gene_group = GROUPS)
sides <- rbind(sides[, .(promoter_set, gene_group, x = SI_CUT - 0.1, label = "broad", hjust = 1)],
               sides[, .(promoter_set, gene_group, x = SI_CUT + 0.1, label = "peaked", hjust = 0)])
for (d in list(n1, sides)) d[, `:=`(promoter_set = factor(promoter_set, levels = names(SET_SHAPES)),
                                   gene_group = factor(gene_group, levels = GROUPS))]
p1 <- ggplot(scored, aes(shape_index, fill = gene_group)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25, boundary = SI_CUT, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = SI_CUT, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_text(data = n1, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("n = ", N)), hjust = -0.15, vjust = 1.5,
            size = 2.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = sides, aes(x = x, y = Inf, label = label, hjust = hjust), vjust = 3.2,
            size = 2.5, colour = "grey30", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(promoter_set ~ gene_group, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(gene_group = GROUP_LABELS)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.35))) +
  labs(x = "shape index (SI)", y = "promoters", title = "Promoter shape index of the example genes",
       caption = sprintf(paste("Promoters with >= %d aggregated GM12878 CAGE tags; dashed line SI = -1",
                               "(Hoskins peaked / Schor narrow above, broad at or below)."), MIN_TAGS)) +
  theme_ps
save_figure(p1, file.path(FIG, "01_shape_index_distribution.pdf"), width = 8, height = 5)
p1
```

## 2. SI against CAGE depth

SI against total CAGE tags for every promoter with at least one tag. Low-depth promoters read as more peaked, which is why promoters below 20 tags (dotted line) stay unclassified.

```{r si-vs-depth, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
p2 <- ggplot(res[total_CAGE_tags > 0], aes(total_CAGE_tags, shape_index, colour = gene_group, shape = promoter_set)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = MIN_TAGS, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = SI_CUT, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.75) +
  annotate("text", x = MIN_TAGS * 1.1, y = -4.6, label = sprintf("%d tags", MIN_TAGS), hjust = 0, size = 2.7,
           colour = "grey30") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, labels = GROUP_LABELS, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = SET_SHAPES, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "total CAGE tags in the promoter (log scale)", y = "shape index (SI)",
       title = "Shape index against CAGE depth",
       caption = "Every promoter with >= 1 tag. Below 20 tags (dotted) SI is low coverage and left unclassified.") +
  theme_ps + guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1), shape = guide_legend(order = 2))
save_figure(p2, file.path(FIG, "02_SI_vs_CAGE_depth.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
p2
```

## 3. SI against the 10-90% initiation width

Initiation concentration (SI) against genomic spread (10-90% initiation width) for promoters with at least 20 tags.

```{r si-vs-width, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
rho <- scored[, cor(shape_index, TSS_width_10_90, method = "spearman")]
p3 <- ggplot(scored, aes(TSS_width_10_90, shape_index, colour = Hoskins_shape_class, shape = promoter_set)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = SI_CUT, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.75, position = position_jitter(width = 0.3, height = 0, seed = 1L)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = CLASS_COLORS, name = "Hoskins class") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = SET_SHAPES, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "10th-90th percentile initiation width (bp)", y = "shape index (SI)",
       title = "Initiation concentration against genomic spread",
       caption = sprintf(paste("Promoters with >= %d tags (n = %d); Spearman rho = %.2f. Widths are",
                               "jittered by up to 0.3 bp; unclassified = bootstrap-unstable."),
                         MIN_TAGS, nrow(scored), rho)) +
  theme_ps + guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1), shape = guide_legend(order = 2))
save_figure(p3, file.path(FIG, "03_SI_vs_TSS_width.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
p3
```

## 4. Classification proportions by gene group

Share of peaked, broad and unclassified promoters per gene group. Schor narrow / broad uses the same cut, so its proportions are identical.

```{r classification, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5}
classes <- res[, .N, by = .(promoter_set, gene_group, Hoskins_shape_class)]
classes[, proportion := N / sum(N), by = .(promoter_set, gene_group)]
classes[, gene_group := factor(GROUP_LABELS[as.character(gene_group)], levels = GROUP_LABELS)]
totals <- classes[, .(label = paste0("n = ", sum(N))), by = .(promoter_set, gene_group)]
p4 <- plot_stacked_proportion(classes, x = "gene_group", fill = "Hoskins_shape_class", colors = CLASS_COLORS,
  y = "proportion", position = "stack", reverse = TRUE, width = 0.7,
  border = list(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4),
  labels = list(x = NULL, y = "fraction of promoters", fill = "Hoskins class",
                title = "Promoter shape classes by gene group",
                caption = paste("Schor narrow / broad uses the same SI = -1 cut, so its proportions are identical.",
                                "Unclassified = no tags, < 20 tags or bootstrap-unstable."),
                inside = list(min_fraction = 0.08, accuracy = 1, vjust = 0.5, color = "white", size = 2.6)),
  totals = list(data = totals, x = "gene_group", y = 1.04, label = "label", style = list(size = 2.7)),
  scales = list(facet_wrap(~ promoter_set), scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                                                               expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06)))),
  theme = theme_ps)
save_figure(p4, file.path(FIG, "04_promoter_classification.pdf"), width = 7, height = 4.5)
p4
```

## 5. Representative nucleotide-resolution profiles

Nucleotide-resolution profiles of four typical peaked and four typical broad dominant_TSS promoters, in transcription-oriented coordinates.

```{r profiles, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.5}
# per class: passing dominant_TSS promoters with at least the class median of tags, then the 4
# whose SI is closest to the class median SI
typical <- res[contains_dominant_TSS & QC_status == "pass"]
typical[, `:=`(median_si = median(shape_index), median_tags = median(total_CAGE_tags)), by = Hoskins_shape_class]
typical <- typical[total_CAGE_tags >= median_tags][order(abs(shape_index - median_si)), head(.SD, 4L),
                                                   by = Hoskins_shape_class]
typical[, label := sprintf("%s (%s)  %s\nSI %.2f | %s tags | 10-90 width %d bp", gene_name, promoter_name,
                           Hoskins_shape_class, shape_index, format(total_CAGE_tags, big.mark = ","), TSS_width_10_90)]
typical[, label := factor(label, levels = label[order(Hoskins_shape_class, -shape_index)])]
prof <- merge(agg, typical[, .(gene_id, promoter_id, label, Hoskins_shape_class)], by = c("gene_id", "promoter_id"))
strongest <- typical[, .(label, x = dominant_TSS_shift, Hoskins_shape_class)]
strongest <- merge(strongest, prof[, .(top = max(count)), by = label], by = "label")
p5 <- ggplot(prof, aes(offset_from_dominant_TSS, count)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = Hoskins_shape_class), width = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dominant_TSS"), linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = strongest, aes(x = x, y = top * 1.08, shape = "strongest_CAGE_TSS"), size = 2.2,
             colour = "black", fill = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ label, ncol = 4, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CLASS_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(dominant_TSS = "dashed"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(strongest_CAGE_TSS = 25), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)), labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = X_OFFSET, y = "aggregated CAGE tags",
       title = "Representative peaked and broad promoters (GM12878 CAGE, 3 replicates summed)",
       caption = paste("Each panel spans its FANTOM5 peak. Chosen per class among passing dominant_TSS promoters",
                       "with >= the class median of tags: the 4 with SI closest to the class median.")) +
  theme_ps + theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "plain", size = 7))
save_figure(p5, file.path(FIG, "05_representative_CAGE_profiles.pdf"), width = 10, height = 5.5)
p5
```

## 6. Dominant_TSS shift

Distance from dominant_TSS to strongest_CAGE_TSS. A: promoters that contain dominant_TSS. B: alternative promoters (pseudo-log scale).

```{r shift, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
dom <- res[contains_dominant_TSS & total_CAGE_tags > 0]
moved <- dom[dominant_TSS_shift != 0][order(dominant_TSS_shift)]
moved[, label_y := 1 + 12 * ((seq_len(.N) - 1L) %% 2L)]   # alternate heights so close shifts do not collide
p6a <- ggplot(dom, aes(dominant_TSS_shift, fill = gene_group)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = moved, aes(x = dominant_TSS_shift, y = label_y, label = sprintf("%s\n(%d tags)", gene_name, total_CAGE_tags)),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 2.3, lineheight = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = nrow(dom) - nrow(moved), label = paste0("n = ", nrow(dom) - nrow(moved)),
           vjust = -0.5, size = 2.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, labels = GROUP_LABELS, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "strongest_CAGE_TSS - dominant_TSS (bp; > 0 = downstream)", y = "promoters",
       title = sprintf("A. Promoters containing dominant_TSS (n = %d with tags)", nrow(dom))) +
  theme_ps
alt <- res[!contains_dominant_TSS & total_CAGE_tags > 0]
p6b <- ggplot(alt, aes(dominant_TSS_shift, fill = gene_group)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 10, base = 10),
                     breaks = c(-1e5, -1e4, -1e3, -100, 0, 100, 1e3, 1e4, 1e5), labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, labels = GROUP_LABELS, name = NULL, drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "strongest_CAGE_TSS - dominant_TSS (bp, pseudo-log scale; > 0 = downstream)", y = "promoters",
       title = sprintf("B. Alternative promoters of the same genes (n = %d with tags)", nrow(alt))) +
  theme_ps
p6 <- (p6a / p6b) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
save_figure(p6, file.path(FIG, "06_dominant_TSS_shift.pdf"), width = 8, height = 7)
p6
```

## 7. Classification stability against depth and SI

Bootstrap classification stability against CAGE depth and SI, for promoters with at least 20 tags.

```{r stability, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.8}
base7 <- list(geom_hline(yintercept = STABILITY_MIN, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey30"),
              scale_colour_manual(values = SIDE_COLORS, name = "observed SI",
                                  labels = c("SI > -1 (peaked / narrow)", "SI <= -1 (broad)")),
              scale_shape_manual(values = SET_SHAPES, name = NULL),
              scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)), theme_ps)
p7a <- ggplot(scored, aes(total_CAGE_tags, classification_stability, colour = side, shape = promoter_set)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.75) + scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) + base7 +
  labs(x = "total CAGE tags (log scale)", y = "classification stability", title = "A. Against CAGE depth")
p7b <- ggplot(scored, aes(shape_index, classification_stability, colour = side, shape = promoter_set)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = SI_CUT, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.75) + base7 +
  labs(x = "shape index (SI)", y = NULL, title = "B. Against shape index")
p7 <- (p7a | p7b) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(caption = sprintf(paste("Fraction of %d multinomial resamples (observed tag total) on the same side",
                                          "of SI = -1; dashed horizontal line = %.1f, below it the class is",
                                          "unstable. Promoters with >= %d tags (n = %d)."),
                                    N_RESAMPLE, STABILITY_MIN, MIN_TAGS, nrow(scored)),
                  theme = theme_ps) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
save_figure(p7, file.path(FIG, "07_classification_stability.pdf"), width = 9, height = 4.8)
p7
```

## 8. Puffin promoter motifs and promoter shape

Puffin motif scores of the PolII example genes (`04a_puffin_motif_scores.tsv`, scored at the same
TSS: Puffin TSS = dominant_TSS - 1) joined to the dominant_TSS promoters that pass QC. Motif
contributions are summed over both strands per motif family. Each feature is tested against SI by
Spearman correlation, and by a rank regression adjusted for gene group, log2 TPM and log10 CAGE
tags; BH-adjusted over features. Puffin is trained on FANTOM CAGE, so its scores are not fully
independent of CAGE-derived shape.

```{r puffin-data}
PUFFIN <- file.path(PROJECT, "LCL_project/pausing/PolII/promoter_annotation/tables/04a_puffin_motif_scores.tsv")
MOTIF_FAMILIES <- c("TATA", "YY1", "SP", "ETS", "NFY", "CREB", "NRF1", "ZNF143")
puffin <- fread(PUFFIN)
for (f in MOTIF_FAMILIES) puffin[, (paste0("motif_", f)) := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = grep(paste0("^", f, " "), names(puffin), value = TRUE)]
puffin[, motif_U1 := `U1 snRNP +`]
puffin[, c("chrom", "strand") := NULL]   # the promoter table already has chr / strand
tpm <- fread(EXAMPLE_GENES)[, .(gene_id, log2_tpm = log2(tpm_mean + 1))]
pm <- merge(merge(res[contains_dominant_TSS & QC_status == "pass"], tpm, by = "gene_id"), puffin, by = "gene_name")
stopifnot(nrow(pm) > 0L, pm$puffin_tss0 == pm$dominant_TSS - 1L)
pm[, `:=`(log10_tags = log10(total_CAGE_tags), puffin_class = group_excl_U1, TATA_class = group_excl_U1 == "TATA")]
PUFFIN_FEATURES <- c(tata_activation = "TATA activation (-27 +/- 3)", motif_TATA = "TATA motif",
  initiator_effect_tss = "initiator effect", trinucleotide_effect_tss = "trinucleotide effect",
  motif_effect_tss = "all motifs effect", total_effect_tss = "total effect",
  dominant_contribution_excl_U1 = "dominant motif contribution", yy1_activation = "YY1 activation",
  setNames(paste(c(MOTIF_FAMILIES[-1], "U1"), "motif"), paste0("motif_", c(MOTIF_FAMILIES[-1], "U1"))))
```

`r nrow(pm)` genes: `r pm[gene_group == "housekeeping", .N]` housekeeping, `r pm[gene_group == "cell_type_specific", .N]` cell type specific.

```{r puffin-tests}
# 1. Spearman rho of SI with each feature, overall and within each gene group
# 2. rank(SI) ~ rank(feature) + gene group + log2 TPM + log10 CAGE tags, on all genes and on
#    genes whose dominant Puffin motif is not TATA (is the effect only the TATA class?)
puffin_test <- function(d, v) {
  m <- lm(rank(shape_index) ~ rank(get(v)) + gene_group + log2_tpm + log10_tags, d)
  c(coef = unname(coef(m)[2]), p = summary(m)$coefficients[2, 4])
}
puffin_tests <- rbindlist(lapply(names(PUFFIN_FEATURES), function(v) {
  rho <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(pm$shape_index, pm[[v]], method = "spearman"))
  within <- pm[, .(rho = cor(shape_index, get(v), method = "spearman")), keyby = gene_group]
  data.table(feature = PUFFIN_FEATURES[[v]], rho = unname(rho$estimate), p = rho$p.value,
             rho_housekeeping = within["housekeeping", rho], rho_cell_type_specific = within["cell_type_specific", rho],
             adjusted_p = puffin_test(pm, v)[["p"]], adjusted_p_non_TATA = puffin_test(pm[TATA_class == FALSE], v)[["p"]])
}))
puffin_tests[, `:=`(fdr = p.adjust(p, "BH"), adjusted_fdr = p.adjust(adjusted_p, "BH"),
                    adjusted_fdr_non_TATA = p.adjust(adjusted_p_non_TATA, "BH"))]
setorder(puffin_tests, adjusted_p)
knitr::kable(puffin_tests[, .(feature, rho, rho_housekeeping, rho_cell_type_specific, fdr, adjusted_fdr, adjusted_fdr_non_TATA)],
  digits = c(0, 2, 2, 2, 4, 4, 4), col.names = c("Puffin feature", "rho", "rho HK", "rho CTS", "FDR",
  "adjusted FDR", "adjusted FDR, non-TATA genes"),
  caption = "Shape index against Puffin features (positive rho = more peaked with a higher score).")
```

```{r puffin-classes}
class_summary <- pm[, .(genes = .N, peaked = sum(Hoskins_shape_class == "peaked"), median_SI = median(shape_index)),
                    by = puffin_class][order(-genes)]
big <- class_summary[genes >= 5L, puffin_class]
kw <- kruskal.test(shape_index ~ factor(puffin_class), pm[puffin_class %in% big])
kw_non_tata <- kruskal.test(shape_index ~ factor(puffin_class), pm[puffin_class %in% setdiff(big, "TATA")])
tata_fisher <- fisher.test(table(pm$TATA_class, pm$Hoskins_shape_class == "peaked"))
knitr::kable(class_summary, digits = 2, col.names = c("Puffin dominant motif", "genes", "peaked", "median SI"),
  caption = sprintf(paste("SI by Puffin dominant motif class. Kruskal-Wallis over classes with >= 5 genes: p = %.2g;",
                          "without the TATA class: p = %.2g. TATA class vs others, peaked fraction %.0f%% vs %.0f%%",
                          "(Fisher p = %.2g)."), kw$p.value, kw_non_tata$p.value,
                    100 * pm[TATA_class == TRUE, mean(Hoskins_shape_class == "peaked")],
                    100 * pm[TATA_class == FALSE, mean(Hoskins_shape_class == "peaked")], tata_fisher$p.value))
```

```{r puffin-features, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.5}
puffin_scatter <- function(v) {
  fdr <- puffin_tests[feature == PUFFIN_FEATURES[[v]], adjusted_fdr]
  ggplot(pm, aes(.data[[v]], shape_index, colour = gene_group, shape = TATA_class)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = SI_CUT, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, labels = GROUP_LABELS, name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 17), labels = c("other Puffin class", "TATA class"), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = PUFFIN_FEATURES[[v]], y = "shape index (SI)", title = sprintf("%s\nadjusted FDR %.2g", PUFFIN_FEATURES[[v]], fdr)) +
    theme_ps
}
p8 <- (puffin_scatter("tata_activation") | puffin_scatter("initiator_effect_tss") | puffin_scatter("total_effect_tss")) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(caption = "Dominant_TSS promoters passing QC; dashed line SI = -1 (peaked above).", theme = theme_ps) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
save_figure(p8, file.path(FIG, "08_SI_vs_puffin_features.pdf"), width = 10, height = 4.5)
p8
```

```{r puffin-class-figure, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
cls <- pm[puffin_class %in% big]
cls[, puffin_class := factor(puffin_class, levels = class_summary[puffin_class %in% big][order(-median_SI), puffin_class])]
p9 <- ggplot(cls, aes(puffin_class, shape_index)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = SI_CUT, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = gene_group), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.8, position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, seed = 1L)) +
  geom_text(data = class_summary[puffin_class %in% big], aes(puffin_class, 2.3, label = sprintf("%d/%d peaked", peaked, genes)),
            size = 2.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, labels = GROUP_LABELS, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(NA, 2.5)) +
  labs(x = "Puffin dominant motif class (classes with >= 5 genes, ordered by median SI)", y = "shape index (SI)",
       title = sprintf("Shape index by Puffin motif class (Kruskal-Wallis p = %.2g; without TATA p = %.2g)",
                       kw$p.value, kw_non_tata$p.value)) +
  theme_ps
save_figure(p9, file.path(FIG, "09_SI_by_puffin_class.pdf"), width = 8, height = 4.5)
p9
```

## 9. Representative genes: CAGE peak decomposition and single molecules

Representative genes picked by agreement between the Puffin dominant motif at dominant_TSS and the
CAGE shape (section 8). Peaked: TATA-class, peaked, deeply covered. Broad: non-TATA class, TATA
activation < 0.2, broad, > 1,000 tags. Discordant: TATA-class but broad (SRSF3), or peaked with
essentially no TATA signal (DYNLL1, RPS6).

```{r representative-table}
REPRESENTATIVES <- data.table(
  gene_name = c("PPIA", "POU2AF1", "ACTG1", "NFKBIA", "SEC61A1", "PSMB1", "RAN", "CD9", "SRSF3", "DYNLL1", "RPS6"),
  role = rep(c("peaked", "broad", "discordant"), c(4L, 4L, 3L)))
REP_DIR <- file.path(FIG, "representative_genes")   # one sub-folder per gene
# dominant Puffin motif site per gene, from 03_puffin_dominant_motif_site.py
motif_sites <- fread(file.path(OUT_DIR, "puffin_dominant_motif_sites.tsv"))
rep_genes <- merge(merge(REPRESENTATIVES, pm, by = "gene_name", sort = FALSE),
                   motif_sites[, .(gene_name, dominant_motif, motif_center)], by = "gene_name", sort = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(rep_genes) == nrow(REPRESENTATIVES))
knitr::kable(rep_genes[, .(gene_name, role, gene_group, dominant_motif, dominant_contribution_excl_U1, motif_center,
                           tata_activation, tata_center, shape_index, Hoskins_shape_class, TSS_width_10_90,
                           dominant_TSS_fraction, total_CAGE_tags)],
  digits = 2, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
  col.names = c("Gene", "Role", "Group", "Puffin dominant motif", "contribution", "motif centre (bp)",
                "TATA activation", "TATA centre (bp)", "SI", "Hoskins class", "10-90 width (bp)",
                "fraction at strongest", "CAGE tags"),
  caption = paste("Representative dominant_TSS promoters. Centres are bp from dominant_TSS: motif centre = peak",
                  "activation of the dominant Puffin motif, TATA centre = Puffin TATA+ peak."))
```

Each CAGE panel spans dominant_TSS -150 to +150 bp in transcription orientation. The three top
tracks are the GM12878 replicates (each scaled to its own maximum in the window); grey bands and
the numbered bottom track are the FANTOM5 decomposed peaks (DPI) on the gene's strand, coloured by
their Hoskins class when they are one of the analysed promoters and labelled with their SI. The
yellow band is the gene's dominant Puffin motif (largest contribution at dominant_TSS, U1 snRNP
excluded; centre +/- 4 bp as for the TATA box of the read-level plots), named in the strip below the
replicates. The dashed line is dominant_TSS.

```{r representative-cage-functions}
CAGE_WINDOW <- c(-150L, 150L)
rep_ctss <- setNames(lapply(names(SAMPLES), read_ctss), names(SAMPLES))
all_peaks <- fantom5_peaks()$peaks
PEAK_COLORS <- c(CLASS_COLORS, "not analysed" = "#d9d9d9")
MOTIF_HALF <- 4L
gene_dir <- function(gene) {
  d <- file.path(REP_DIR, gene)
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  d
}

# per-replicate CTSS around one gene's dominant_TSS and the FANTOM5 peaks there, on the TSS-relative axis
cage_window <- function(g) {
  lo <- g$dominant_TSS + if (g$strand == "+") CAGE_WINDOW[1] else -CAGE_WINDOW[2]
  hi <- g$dominant_TSS + if (g$strand == "+") CAGE_WINDOW[2] else -CAGE_WINDOW[1]
  rel <- function(x) (x - g$dominant_TSS) * strand_sign(g$strand)
  signal <- rbindlist(lapply(names(SAMPLES), function(s)
    rep_ctss[[s]][chr == g$chr & strand == g$strand & pos >= lo & pos <= hi, .(offset = rel(pos), count, sample = s)]))
  signal[, `:=`(scaled = count / max(count), replicate = sprintf("%s (%s)", SAMPLES[sample], sample)), by = sample]
  peaks <- all_peaks[chr == g$chr & strand == g$strand & end >= lo & start <= hi]
  peaks[, `:=`(x1 = pmin(rel(start), rel(end)) - 0.5, x2 = pmax(rel(start), rel(end)) + 0.5)]
  setorder(peaks, x1)
  peaks[, number := .I]
  peaks <- merge(peaks, res[gene_id == g$gene_id, .(promoter_id, shape_index, Hoskins_shape_class)],
                 by = "promoter_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  peaks[, `:=`(class = factor(fifelse(is.na(Hoskins_shape_class), "not analysed", as.character(Hoskins_shape_class)),
                              levels = names(PEAK_COLORS)),
               label = fifelse(is.na(shape_index), as.character(number), sprintf("%d  SI %.2f", number, shape_index)))]
  list(signal = signal, peaks = peaks[order(number)])
}

# replicate CAGE tracks (plot_group_profile), the dominant Puffin motif strip and the numbered
# decomposed-peak track (plot_interval_track)
plot_cage_decomposition <- function(gene) {
  g <- rep_genes[gene_name == gene]
  w <- cage_window(g)
  motif_box <- g$motif_center + c(-MOTIF_HALF - 0.5, MOTIF_HALF + 0.5)
  bands <- as.data.frame(rbind(
    w$peaks[, .(xmin = x1, xmax = x2, fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.6, position = "under")],
    data.table(xmin = motif_box[1], xmax = motif_box[2], fill = "#FFFF00", alpha = 0.6, position = "under")))
  top <- plot_group_profile(w$signal, window = CAGE_WINDOW, x_col = "offset", y_col = "scaled", style = "column",
    facet_col = "replicate",
    layers = list(list(geom = "col", width = 1, fill = "#2878B5")),
    highlight = bands,
    markers = list(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30"),
    labels = list(x = NULL, y = "CAGE (scaled)",
                  title = sprintf("%s (%s, %s): SI %.2f, Puffin %s, TATA activation %.2f", g$gene_name, g$role,
                                  GROUP_LABELS[[g$gene_group]], g$shape_index, g$puffin_class, g$tata_activation)),
    scales = list(scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)), scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))),
    theme = theme_ps + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                             strip.text = element_text(face = "plain", hjust = 0)))
  motif_strip <- ggplot() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30") +
    annotate("rect", xmin = motif_box[1], xmax = motif_box[2], ymin = 0.2, ymax = 0.8, fill = "#FFFF00",
             colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    annotate("text", x = motif_box[2] + 5, y = 0.5, hjust = 0, size = 2.7,
             label = sprintf("%s motif (Puffin centre %d bp, contribution %.2f)", sub(" ", "", g$dominant_motif),
                             g$motif_center, g$dominant_contribution_excl_U1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = CAGE_WINDOW, expand = c(0, 0)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Puffin") + theme_ps +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank())
  track <- plot_interval_track(w$peaks, window = CAGE_WINDOW, start_col = "x1", end_col = "x2", fill_col = "class",
    colors = PEAK_COLORS, height = 0.5,
    labels = list(x = X_OFFSET, y = NULL, fill = "decomposed peak"),
    scales = list(scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.4, 2), breaks = NULL), scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)),
                  scale_fill_manual(values = PEAK_COLORS)),
    theme = theme_ps + theme(axis.line.y = element_blank())) +
    geom_text(data = w$peaks, aes(x = (x1 + x2) / 2, y = 1.55, label = label), size = 2.4, check_overlap = TRUE) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30")
  p <- top / motif_strip / track + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 0.4, 1))
  save_figure(p, file.path(gene_dir(gene), paste0(gene, "_CAGE_peaks.pdf")), width = 8, height = 4.8)
  p
}
```

```{r representative-cage, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.8}
for (gene in REPRESENTATIVES$gene_name) print(plot_cage_decomposition(gene))
```

Single molecules: the read-level figure of `plot_read_level()` from the PolII analysis, drawn as in
the TATA section of `code/pausing/PolII/summarize_recurrent_patterns.Rmd` (TSS +/- 1 kb, every
full-span read, nucleosomes and 10-80 bp TF footprints, m6A fraction of all reads, Pol II ChIP)
with the Puffin TATA box (`tata_center` +/- 4 bp) shaded yellow for every gene. For broad and
discordant genes the TATA box is Puffin's strongest TATA+ position even when its activation is weak
(see the table). PDFs are written to `figures/representative_genes/<gene>/<gene>_read_level.pdf`; existing
PDFs are reused unless `REDRAW_MOLECULES` is TRUE (each gene reads all 31 samples, minutes per gene).

```{r representative-molecule-functions}
REDRAW_MOLECULES <- FALSE
# the PolII helpers live in their own environment: their OUT_DIR / SAMPLES differ from ours
dyn.load("/project/spott/cshan/envs/dimelo/lib/libcurl.so.4", local = FALSE)
pol2 <- new.env()
sys.source(file.path(PROJECT, "code/pausing/PolII/pol2_pausing_functions.r"), envir = pol2)

show_pdf_pages <- function(pdf, dpi = 100) {
  out <- tempfile()
  status <- system2("/project/spott/cshan/envs/poppler/bin/pdftoppm", c("-png", "-r", dpi, shQuote(pdf), shQuote(out)))
  pngs <- sort(Sys.glob(paste0(out, "-*.png")))
  if (status != 0 || !length(pngs)) stop("pdftoppm failed on ", pdf)
  pngs
}

# plot_tata_read_level() of summarize_recurrent_patterns.Rmd, on the promoter-shape gene table
plot_shape_read_level <- function(gene) {
  r <- rep_genes[gene_name == gene]
  g <- data.table(group = r$gene_group, gene_name = r$gene_name, chrom = r$chr, tss = r$dominant_TSS,
                  strand = r$strand, tss_source = r$dominant_TSS_source)
  out <- file.path(gene_dir(gene), paste0(gene, "_read_level.pdf"))
  if (file.exists(out) && !REDRAW_MOLECULES) return(out)
  local({
    region <- data.frame(region_id = g$gene_name, chr = g$chrom,
      start = g$tss + EXAMPLE_RANGE[1] - 1L, end = g$tss + EXAMPLE_RANGE[2],
      analysis_start = g$tss + EXAMPLE_RANGE[1], analysis_end = g$tss + EXAMPLE_RANGE[2])
    samples <- fread(SAMPLES)[, .(sample_name, fire_dir)]
    dat <- assemble_region_m6a(as.data.frame(samples), region, full_span = TRUE,
      positions = seq(region$analysis_start, region$analysis_end))
    meta <- dat$rids_df
    plain <- meta$RID[order(match(meta$sample_name, samples$sample_name), meta$start, meta$RID)]
    plot_read_level(g, example_footprints(g, dat), plain, out, met_mat = dat$met_mat,
                    tata_center = r$tata_center, motif_label = sprintf("TATA box (activation %.2f)", r$tata_activation))
  }, envir = list2env(list(g = g, r = r, out = out), parent = pol2))
  out
}
```

```{r representative-molecules, out.width = "100%"}
molecule_pdfs <- vapply(REPRESENTATIVES$gene_name, plot_shape_read_level, character(1))
knitr::include_graphics(unlist(lapply(molecule_pdfs, show_pdf_pages)))
```
